official_stems: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

confidence_rules.high: prompt is 'conforms to the conventions of Standard English' AND choices differ primarily in punctuation/sentence structure
confidence_rules.medium: prompt is 'conforms to the conventions of Standard English' AND choices mix punctuation with verb forms
confidence_rules.low: prompt is 'conforms to the conventions of Standard English' AND choices are all about verb forms/agreement

official_stems: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
positive_signals: conforms to the conventions of Standard English
skills.check_options: If answer choices differ in verb forms, subject-verb agreement, pronoun case, noun number, possessive forms, modifier placement, or comparative structures, classify as Form, Structure, and Sense.

subtype_examples.verb_form: Tense, aspect, voice, infinitive vs. gerund
subtype_examples.subject_verb_agreement: Singular vs. plural verb with complex subject
subtype_examples.modifier: Dangling modifier, misplaced modifier, comparative forms

confidence_rules.high: prompt is 'conforms to the conventions of Standard English' AND choices differ in verb forms / agreement / pronouns
confidence_rules.medium: prompt is 'conforms to the conventions of Standard English' without clear grammatical pattern
